name: E-Mountainbike Sunset Tour
beschreibung:
The Ötztal is one of the Alps' premier bike destinations – and e-mountain bike tours let you enjoy the valley's dramatic elevation and scenic alpine trails without professional-level fitness. Guided sunset tours are especially popular, with the setting sun bathing the 3,000 m peaks in golden light.

Sunset Rides

Bike Republic Sölden extends Gaislachkoglbahn I operations every Friday in July and August until 19:15 (last uphill), with trails open until 20:00 for official sunset rides. Providers such as E-Bike Guide Ötztal by Lohmann, RIDE ON Sölden and Feelfree Bike Center offer tailor-made private sunset tours. Typical: start ~16:30–17:00, ride up to scenic alms (e.g. Kleblealm 1,983 m), watch the sunset, descend in fading light. Duration: ~3–4 hours. Private guiding from ~€99 per person (guide only, bike extra).

Regular Guided Tours

AREA 47 (Haiming): „E-MTB All Ride“ (20 km / 500 m ascent, ~3.5 hrs, ~€83 incl. rental e-MTB). Bikeschule Ötztal: guided tours Tue & Thu (mid-June–mid-Sept), 13:30–16:30, ~3 hrs, ~€109 incl. e-bike rental. E-Bike Guide Ötztal: weekly „Ebike meets Trail“ (Wed), 4–5 hrs, €39 guiding fee (without bike).

Getting There

Ötztal Bike Bus: all line buses Haiming–Obergurgl run half-hourly with bike trailers (up to 16 bikes, incl. e-bikes). Free with Ötztal Inside Summer Card. ÖBB station: Ötztal-Bahnhof/Haiming.
